about: Saint-Lambert is a South Shore city in Montérégie, directly across the St. Lawrence from downtown Montréal via the Victoria Bridge. It is an older, leafy suburban city with a strong anglophone heritage, Victoria Avenue shops, and riverfront parks facing the harbour. Commuter trains and bridges tie it tightly to the island. About 23,000 people live in Saint-Lambert.
seoSummary: Leafy South Shore city facing Montréal across the Victoria Bridge, with a historic riverside core.
knownFor: Leafy streets and anglophone South Shore heritage
